calls.statement:
SELECT f.vat_rate, f.sale_date >= DATE '2024-09-01' AS from_sep1, count(*) AS n_lines, count(DISTINCT s.store_id) AS stores,
  sum(f.net_amount) AS net, sum(f.gross_amount) AS gross, sum(f.gross_amount - f.net_amount) AS vat,
  sum(round(f.net_amount*f.vat_rate,2)) AS vat_by_rate, min(f.sale_date) AS d0, max(f.sale_date) AS d1,
  sum(CASE WHEN f.staff_purchase_flag THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS staff_lines,
  sum(CASE WHEN p.category='ZZ Test' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS test_lines
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-26' AND DATE '2024-09-22'
GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

WITH l AS (
 SELECT f.* FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
 WHERE s.store_id<900 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-26' AND DATE '2024-09-22'),
dups AS (SELECT count(*) AS lines, count(DISTINCT sales_line_id) AS uniq_ids, count(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)) AS uniq_rl FROM l),
ctl AS (SELECT sum(net_sales_before_returns) AS rpt_gross_net, sum(returns_net) AS rpt_returns, sum(net_sales) AS rpt_net FROM rpt_daily_store_sales
 WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-26' AND DATE '2024-09-22' AND store_id<900),
mine AS (SELECT sum(net_amount) AS my_net, count(*) AS n, sum(CASE WHEN channel_code='WB' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS wb_lines, sum(CASE WHEN net_amount<=0 OR quantity<=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS nonpos FROM l),
ret AS (SELECT sum(r.refund_net) AS ret_net, sum(r.refund_gross-r.refund_net) AS ret_vat, count(*) AS n_ret FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key
 WHERE s.store_id<900 AND r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-26' AND DATE '2024-09-22')
SELECT * FROM dups, ctl, mine, ret

calls.statement:
SELECT 'FY2024/25' AS fiscal_year, 5 AS fiscal_period, f.vat_rate AS vat_rate,
       SUM(f.gross_amount - f.net_amount) AS vat_charged
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
  AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-26' AND DATE '2024-09-22'
GROUP BY f.vat_rate
ORDER BY f.vat_rate
